Page template

page_template.Rd

Size, margins, header and footer shared by a set of pages. Header and footer are blocks or `function(ctx)` returning a block, where `ctx` holds `page`, `pages` and the page's `data`. Text in [bb_running_header()] and [bb_page_footer()] can use `{page}` and `{pages}` directly.

Usage

page_template(
  width = 8.5,
  height = 11,
  margin_x = 0.5,
  margin_top = 0.5,
  margin_bottom = 0.5,
  header = NULL,
  footer = NULL,
  header_gap = 0.2,
  footer_gap = 0.2,
  theme = NULL,
  background = NA
)

Arguments

width, height

Page size (`grid::unit` or inches). US Letter by default.

margin_x

Side margins: one value, or left and right.

margin_top, margin_bottom

Top and bottom margins.

header, footer

Default header and footer (block, function, or `NULL`).

header_gap, footer_gap

Space between header/footer and body.

theme

Optional [bb_theme()] applied while these pages are exported.

background

Page background colour, or `NA`.

Value

A `bb_page_template` object.

Details

Layout of a page, top to bottom: - `margin_top`, then the header and `header_gap`. A full-bleed header (a [bb_banner()]) sits flush with the top edge instead. - the body, between the side margins (full-bleed body blocks span the page width). - `footer_gap`, the footer, then `margin_bottom`. The footer is anchored to the bottom margin, so it is in the same place on every page.

Examples

tpl <- page_template(margin_x = 0.5,
                     footer = bb_page_footer("My report", "{page} / {pages}"))
